ingredientSections.heading: Bubble Gum Shatter
items: 50g Dried Berries; strawberries, blueberries, raspberries or similar

ingredientSections.heading: Meyer Lemon Curd
items: ½ Cup Meyer Lemon Juice, regular lemons are ok too
2 tsp Meyer Lemon Zest, finely grated
6 Tbsp Unsalted Butter, cut into cubes

methodSections.heading: Hominy Cornmeal Cake
steps: Mix cornmeal, sugar and milk together and bring to a boil.
Allow to cool, mix in the remaining ingredients and spread to around 4cm (1½in) thick in an oven proof pan or dish.
Bake at 160°C (325°F) for 25 minutes or until golden brown.

methodSections.heading: Bubble Gum Shatter
steps: Place all the ingredients in a saucepan and heat until just about to boil. Remove from heat, place in a container, allow to cool and then refrigerate overnight.
Strain through a sieve and discard the berries and guava. Whip to soft peaks, spread out thinly on a tray and freeze.
When frozen solid, working quickly, place in a food processor and blend to get the shattered effect. Quickly place in a container and store in the freezer.

methodSections.heading: Tea Infused Strawberries
steps: Warm the wine, sugar and the tea bags and place into a resealable storage bag with the strawberries. Remove all the air from the bag and refrigerate overnight.

methodSections.heading: Meyer Lemon Curd
steps: Whisk together the juice, zest, sugar and eggs in a heavy saucepan.
Stir in the butter and cook over medium low heat, whisking frequently, until curd is thick enough to hold the marks of a whisk and coats the back of a spoon.
Transfer the lemon curd to a bowl and allow to cool. Cover its surface with plastic wrap and then place in fridge.

methodSections.heading: Berry Sorbet
steps: Place all ingredients into a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Remove from heat, blend until smooth and strain through a fine chinois or sieve.
Allow to cool and then spin in an ice cream machine until set. Store in freezer.

methodSections.heading: To Serve
steps: Working as quickly as possible, plate each element in portions and a design the inspires you, on chilled plates or bowls.
Garnish with edible flowers, micro sorrel, cracked pink peppercorns and dill pollen.
